```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table); library(tinytable)
dt <- data.table(
  工程 = c("デザイン・仮説", "データ収集・整理", "推敲"),
  人間 = c("作り出す", "指示を出す", "監修、編集"),
  AI   = c("理論枠組み、仮説、データの整合性チェック", "指示通りに作業", "推計結果を表にして簡単な文章にする")
)
make_tt <- function(w) {
  tb <- tt(dt, width = w)
  tb <- style_tt(tb, j = 1:3, align = "l", fontsize = .8)
  tb <- style_tt(tb, i = 0, align = "c")
  theme_html(tb, class = "tinytable tinytable-hover")
}
```

## Test A: sum=0.75 (original), no CSS

```{r testA}
make_tt(c(.2, .15, .4))   # sum = 0.75 — original code
```

---

## Test B: sum=0.70 (fix), no CSS

```{r testB}
make_tt(c(.187, .14, .373))   # sum = 0.70 — our fix
```

---

## Test C: sum=0.75 + CSS override (width:auto !important)

```{=html}
<style>
.reveal section.testC table.tinytable { width: auto !important; }
</style>
```

```{r testC}
make_tt(c(.2, .15, .4))   # sum = 0.75 + CSS override
```

---

## Test D: no width arg (CSS variable drives width)

```{r testD}
make_tt(NULL)   # no width arg — CSS variable --tt-table-width: 100%
```

---

## Test E: sum=1.0 (explicit full width)

```{r testE}
make_tt(1)   # explicit width=1 → inline width:100%
```
